hook: Yang forced automation and AI's threat to jobs onto the American political stage years before generative AI made the subject unavoidable, building an entire 2020 presidential campaign, and a signature policy proposal, around the argument that AI-driven job loss required a fundamental rethink of the social safety net.
name: Andrew Yang

quote.text: The reason Donald Trump is our president today is that we automated away four million manufacturing jobs in Michigan, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, all the swing states.
quote.context: Andrew Yang, first Democratic presidential primary debate, June 2019

moniker: Politician Who Made Automation a National Issue

primary.name: The War on Normal People, Andrew Yang (Hachette Books, 2018)
Andrew Yang, official biography, Forward Party

secondary.name: Andrew Yang's Long-Shot Bid Is Powered by Fear of the Robot Apocalypse, The New York Times (2019)

timeline.impact: Entrepreneurship fellowship aimed at struggling U.S. cities

timeline.event: Publishes The War on Normal People
timeline.impact: Automation and AI job loss enters mainstream political debate
Universal Basic Income proposed as an AI-era policy response

timeline.event: Qualifies for and participates in multiple Democratic primary debates
timeline.impact: Automation policy reaches a national audience
Continues advocacy through a new political vehicle

quick_facts: Founded Venture for America, a fellowship placing entrepreneurs in struggling cities
Ran for U.S. President in 2020 centered on automation and a Universal Basic Income proposal
Author of The War on Normal People (2018), on AI-driven job displacement

achievements.title: Founding Venture for America (2011)
achievements.impact: A fellowship program that placed hundreds of young entrepreneurs in startups in economically struggling U.S. cities, aimed at broadening the geography of tech job creation.

achievements.title: The War on Normal People (2018)
achievements.impact: Argued that automation and AI would eliminate millions of American jobs faster than new ones could replace them, bringing the issue into mainstream political discourse.

achievements.title: 2020 U.S. presidential campaign
achievements.impact: Built a campaign around a $1,000/month Universal Basic Income (the 'Freedom Dividend') as a policy response to automation, reaching national debate stages.

achievements.title: Co-founding the Forward Party (2021)
achievements.impact: Launched a political organization continuing to advocate for policy responses to technological and economic disruption.
